title: The Wet Backpack Mystery
question: 把今天的“查原因 + 排除常见可能 + 偶然发现线索 + 解开谜团”放进一个安全的生活场景：湿书包谜案。用 word bank 补完整 5 个空。
example_answer: At last, I found out why my backpack was wet. At first, I thought it was caused by rain. I examined the books carefully. I was not able to find any rainwater on the outside. Then I accidentally discovered the cause. My water bottle was not closed properly. In this way, I solved the mystery.
